name: ViP-NeRF
definition: A method that introduces visibility priors to supervise density and improve rendering quality under sparse input view conditions (fewer than 50-100 views), preventing artifacts caused by insufficient training data.
summary: ViP-NeRF is a NeRF training procedure that improves sparse-view rendering by using planar scanned volumes to compute visibility priors for density regularization without pre-training.
